name: Minds 6: hoarders alive against the share of cheaters
description: The number of hoarders alive at the end of the first winter (hoarder_alive; window_mean, ticks 190–200) in theft-winter-half's world (each cache found with chance 0.25; cheaters never cache and take what they can carry of any cache they find; γ = 100, β = 32) against the share of agents that cheat (theft.cheaters): 0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75 or 0.9, dealt by id. The sweep format takes one metric and no ratio, so it reports the hoarders' head count, not the hoarder–cheater survival gap; the per-capita gap (hoarder_alive and cheater_alive against each group's starting size) comes from the survey. Seeds 1–20.
